cohort: Women who delivered at a metropolitan hospital in Sydney over a five-year period
finding: While there was no difference in caesarean section rates between women with and without FGM, women with FGM were less likely to have an instrumental delivery and those with FGM 3 were more likely to have an episiotomy.
mod_finding: Women with FGM were less likely to be delivered by vacuum or forceps compared to women without FGM.
